title: Minor New Source Review Program Air Permitting Public Participation Requirements for State Implementation Plans
abstract: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) is proposing to revise the public participation regulatory requirements for sources subject to Clean Air Act (CAA) New Source Review (NSR) programs approved into State Implementation Plans (SIPs). Specifically, the EPA is proposing to recognize in regulation that State and local air quality regulatory authorities ("air agencies") determine, pursuant to the CAA, whether, when, and to what extent public participation in minor NSR programs is necessary
